metaTitle: Yaad — Fast, Private Notes & Connected Ideas

hero.subtitle: Yaad is a fast, private note editor. Capture thoughts, link ideas visually, and work completely offline — no account needed.

bento.title: Everything you need to think clearly.
bento.description: Fast, simple, and completely private. No confusing menus, no subscription walls, no waiting on cloud sync.
bento.featureGraphDesc: See how all your notes connect. An interactive graph maps out your workspace automatically — no folders needed.
bento.featureBlocksDesc: Type "/" to insert headings, checklists, code blocks, callouts, and nested sub-pages inline.
bento.featureSearchDesc: Find any note, tag, or idea in milliseconds. Works offline, completely indexed on your device.
bento.featurePrivacyDesc: Your notes never leave your device. No telemetry, no cloud sync, no tracking. You own your data.
bento.featurePeekDesc: Open linked notes in a side panel to reference while you write — no tab-switching needed.
bento.previewBlocksRoadmapDesc: A plan for the next quarter, broken into milestones and tasks.
bento.previewPrivacyDesc: All notes are stored directly on your computer. No cloud servers, no telemetry, no tracking. Export or back up anytime.
bento.previewPeekNote: Yaad uses a local Rust-powered SQLite database via Tauri.

workflow.title: A natural way to organize your ideas.
workflow.description: Traditional folders can feel rigid and easy to forget. Yaad makes it easy to capture ideas quickly and discover how they connect.
workflow.step1Desc: Open the app in an instant and start typing. Organize thoughts using intuitive blocks and quick slash commands.
workflow.step2Desc: Nest sub-pages infinitely with /page. Organize notes and complex projects with a clean, natural hierarchy.
workflow.step3Desc: Open the visual graph to see the big picture. Watch how your notes, ideas, and projects branch out and connect.
workflow.step4Desc: Press ⌘K anytime. Even years later, find any note, idea, or past meeting summary in a fraction of a second.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Everything you need to know about Yaad and how it keeps your notes private.
faq.q1: What makes Yaad different from other note apps?
faq.a1: Yaad combines clean, block-based writing with visual note connections—without heavy memory usage, complex setups, or slow startup times. It opens in a flash, feels lightweight, and keeps you focused on writing.
faq.q2: Where are my notes and data stored?
faq.a2: 100% locally on your own machine. On desktop, notes are saved directly to your computer's local drive. In the browser, they are stored securely in your browser's private storage. We never track your keystrokes, run analytics on your notes, or lock your thoughts behind cloud servers.
faq.a3: Yes. Yaad is 100% free and open-source. There are no artificial paywalls, document limits, or subscription traps.
faq.a4: Yaad runs as a native app on macOS (Apple Silicon & Intel), Windows 10/11, and Linux. You can also use it directly in any modern web browser with zero installation.
faq.a5: Yes, anytime. Your notes belong completely to you. You can export individual documents or your entire workspace into clean text or standard Markdown files with your links preserved.
